title: Meta introduces camera-free AI glasses | TechCrunch
summary: Alongside the glasses, Meta announced its next-generation AI glasses (the ones with cameras), the Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 3). All of Meta’s AI glasses will, of course, feature access to its newer personal AI assistant, Muse.
